_readme: AI-ASSIGNED, NOT MEASURED. Every word below is a curated dictionary entry that no frequency corpus attests AND that the base-form rules in src/game/dictionary.ts cannot fold onto a measured base -- so there is nothing at all to score it from. Words those rules do resolve are deliberately absent: they score off real data and need no judgement. These tiers are a judgement call about whether the word is a genuine rare headword or a form the suffix machinery merely permits. Grading only ever lowers a score, never raises one, and is ignored entirely unless it moves the score by at least 0.3 (MIN_GRADE_DROP in src/game/dictionary.ts) -- so a word listed here may keep the score it already had. Applies to puzzles from 2026-08-19. Regenerate with scripts/classify-unattested.py; override individual calls by editing this file (the generator preserves nothing, so record manual edits in the repo history).

inherit._meaning: Spelling variant or inflection: scores off the listed base word's frequency.

lemma._meaning: Standalone headword, nothing strippable. Keeps the perfect 10.00.

derived._meaning: Transparent derivation off the listed attested base. Score capped at 9.80.

artifact._meaning: Suffix-machinery form off the listed base. Score capped at 9.50, below Legend.
